points: A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to stick to the rules.
As AI models become more capable, safety researchers are scrambling to ensure they are “aligned” with human desires—to make sure, in other words, that rogue agents don’t

stories.originalTitle: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
stories.summary: AI agents that interact with enterprise APIs on behalf of users need to maintain user identity throughout the request chain. Without identity propagation, API calls arrive at downstream services as the application itself rather than the user who initiated the
points: AI agents that interact with enterprise APIs on behalf of users need to maintain user identity throughout the request chain.
Without identity propagation, API calls arrive at downstream services as the application itself rather than the user who initiated the action.
This breaks audit trails, bypasses user-level access controls, and violates the principle of least privilege.
